skill_rules.costs: by_level is the listed CP cost for each sequential level; repeat_cost applies to later levels when unlimited is true. A '*' cost marker is preserved in annotations_by_level; the source notes that Personal Magic's marked levels cost no CP.
skill_rules.status: blue, grey, and red are normalized lowercase; grey skills do not qualify for either blue or red creation limits.
skill_rules.dependencies: Requirements retain their source expression; top-level OR creates alternatives, comma-separated terms are conjunctive, and parenthesized expressions remain intact. Teacher requirements are separate.
skill_rules.purchase_grants: grants_on_purchase lists free levels or spell slots included when the skill is purchased; these grants are not additional CP purchases.
